text_block_list.text: With her debut race over, we need to decide Air Groove's next goal...
If we are to choose a race worthy of the "Empress"—

The Umamusume who conquers the Hanshin JF is hailed as the queen of that year's Junior class.
It is the ideal challenge for Air Groove.

Still, what does Air Groove herself think?
To find out, I decided to go look for her.

text_block_list.name: Student Council Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Vice President. I've finished inspecting the school equipment.
Here is the summarized list.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I'll take care of verifying the rest on my end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
......Phew.
Next is sorting documents in the student council room, huh—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mmhââ
Oh, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Unless it is an urgent matter, leave it for later.
I have paperwork to organize in the student council room now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What did you say?
Since this concerns our future direction, I wanted to take the time to talk as soon as possible. I conveyed that intention to Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You want to help out to free up some time?
...Hmph. You've gotten quite bold with your words.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—What are you doing? We're heading to the student council room.
If you're going to do this, I expect you to work thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Well now—
Air Groove's Trainer is with you today, I see."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to have them help with the filing scheduled for today,
would that be all right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind.
In fact, the timing is quite perfect."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A member of the beautification committee was here looking for you just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like an urgent matter.
Could you go hear what they have to say in person?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In the meantime, he and I will handle sorting the documents.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In the meantime, she and I will handle sorting the documents.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's what happened...
I have an idea of which matter this is, so I'll head over right away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now then—

...Quite unexpectedly, I found myself
alone with Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, shall we get started right away?
I'm counting on you.

...Symboli Rudolf worked so efficiently
that sorting through the mountain of paperwork
finished much sooner than expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—You have my thanks. Thanks to you,
I was able to finish before Air Groove returned.”
choice_data_list: No, thank you for letting me help out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"‘Let me help you,’ is it...
I see. That speaks volumes about your relationship."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because you are who you are—
that there is something I must ask you about Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (――President?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Just what were the two of them talking about...?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...As you know, she is extremely dedicated
to both her Student Council duties and looking after the younger students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she ran a splendid debut race the other day,
never neglecting her duties.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, she will surely continue to discipline herself and aim for even greater heights,
all while dedicating herself body and soul to other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That journey is full of hardships. At worst—
one might fall to their knees midway, trapped at an impasse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Right now, you are watching her closer than anyone.
Therefore, this is what I wish to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Is Air Groove pushing herself too hard?
Symboli Rudolf looked directly at me as she asked the question.
Hearing that, the first words of Air Groove's that came to mind were—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll say it again.
Under no circumstances are you to let your guard down. And—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Keep up with me, without fail.
That day when she made her debut, she told me that. In that case, as her Trainer, I—
choice_data_list: I believe in the path Air Groove is taking.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...'Constant dripping wears away the stone', is it?
You two might actually be more alike than you think.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It seems I asked an overly forward question.
...Thanks again for today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll let Air Groove know that you went ahead to the Trainer's office.
Taking Symboli Rudolf up on her offer, I returned to the trainer's office to wait for Air Groove, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well. More importantly,
about our plans going forward—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —We're taking the Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I will win here...
and reign as the Queen of the Junior Class."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that...
the President's worries should be put to rest as well."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I cause her unnecessary worry,
I cannot truly be the ideal "Empress."

Could she have overheard the conversation with Symboli Rudolf earlier?
I felt a slight prickle of concern, but—

With her showing signs of something akin to frustration, there was no need to question her further.
As her Trainer, I had other things I needed to do right now.
choice_data_list: I was thinking about the Hanshin JF as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh.
So even you have started to understand a little, have you?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Regarding your conduct today...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well... that was fairly helpful.
I suppose I shall express my gratitude.
choice_data_list: Don't hesitate to lean on me.
Don't hesitate to lean on me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Heh. Fool.
Don't let it get to your head."

Our next target has been set: the Hanshin JF!
We're aiming to become... the Junior Queen!
